ordered_gates.name: covariate_linked_factor_analytic_decomposition
ordered_gates.projection_rule: all_environment_factor_loadings_used for prediction must be functions of certified prospective covariates; free observed-environment residuals belong only to the later adapter

ordered_gates.name: locked_pheno_sinn_factorial_ablation
ordered_gates.entry_condition: FA backbone, phenology module, and SINN residual specifications have each reached terminal inner-validation decisions and their survivor hashes are frozen

factorial_ablation.SINN_training_rule: train only on cross-fitted statistical residual pseudo-targets from the inner-training partition; do not jointly fine-tune the frozen statistical core in the initial factorial
factorial_ablation.phenology_training_rule: use only fold-local or cross-fitted predicted phenology; observed validation DTH or DTM is forbidden

screen_sequence.balanced_confirmation: 25 matched states: one preregistered inner fold for each scenario x outer-fold combination
screen_sequence.definitive_confirmation: all 125 matched inner states before an architectural synergy claim or outer-protocol freeze

interpretation.strict_synergy: full model beats both single-addition cells and the scenario/outer-fold clustered 95% interval for the NRMSE interaction is entirely below zero
interpretation.complementarity_without_superadditivity: both conditional gains are positive and the full model passes all frozen guards, while the interaction interval includes zero
interpretation.redundancy: one component has no positive conditional gain after the other is present
interpretation.antagonism: adding either component conditionally worsens NRMSE or causes a frozen guard failure
interpretation.no_synergy_claim: interaction uncertainty crosses zero or definitive 125-state confirmation is incomplete

factorial_ablation.uncertainty: cluster paired results by scenario and outer fold; inner folds within a cluster are not treated as independent replicates

permitted_horizon_evidence: published external agronomic wheat season bounds selected without model-performance evidence
nonphenotypic sowing and harvest management metadata
phenotype-blind historical and future daily archive coverage
required_release_checks: evidence sources and deterministic endpoint rule frozen before endpoint calculation
historical and future daily coverage through the selected endpoint
identical historical and future variable derivation
150 split-bound historical states rebuilt with training-only transformations
no protected phenotype or outcome access

product_policy.historical_known_environment: may add the frozen support-shrunk empirical-Bayes adapter
product_policy.projection_compatible: must use prospective covariates, predicted phenology, K_A, soil, management scenarios, and explicit masks only
